about: Probes run by `verify_api.py smoke`. `free: true` spends no token (no LLM call, no cache write). Paid probes run with cache read and write off, so each one goes through the whole pipeline; on a warm provider cache the set costs about 0.10 USD, the first question after a restart about 0.13 USD alone. Expectations were measured on 1.1.20 (violet) on 2026-11-24. A probe with `known_issue` reports KNOWN instead of FAIL while the defect it names is open; remove the field when the fix ships, so the probe guards against a regression.

probes.question: Which films did Alfred Hitchcock direct in the 1950s?
Quels films Alfred Hitchcock a-t-il réalisés dans les années 1950 ?
How many feature films did Stanley Kubrick direct?
What are the 5 longest films directed by Christopher Nolan?
probes.known_issue: FASTAPI-TEXT2SQL-416 (2026-11-24): an anthology of shorts ('Cinema16: British Short Films', where Nolan directed one short) ranks first; feature-film scope is not applied to 'films directed by'
